非Default通过显式模拟class对照；原生pseudo-state、paint层绘制顺序、SVG轮廓与实际动画没有据此验收。
Processing原始节点只有loader，gap有缺省/10px/4px差异；当前隐藏文字保宽及absolute loader的gap/flow不据此宣称等同或已验收。
Actual saved COMPONENT_SET/COMPONENT types establish component identity; left/right position and wrapper names do not.
Visibility property declarations and design fonts/colors are not browser computed styles.
TextButton design properties do not independently approve Footer adapter or its black/S class.
Independent complete specification and current browser proof remain pending.
Node types establish component identity; specification document is separately indexed.
Saved design DSL is not original frontend source or browser rendering.
S has declared padding 6px but saved icon insets 3px. Existing current CSS/contract use 3px; this is an adaptation, not a source-padding match.
Hand cursor INSTANCE 671:385 is a saved annotation, not another icon or implemented hover behavior.
Plain Hover checks only explicit simulation classes. Bordered Hover has no typed source counterpart and is not inferred from checked state.
Unregistered pinned/calendar icons, SVG contours, full specification and browser acceptance remain pending.
S raw 8px padding is preserved separately from current 0 8px runtime declaration; source axis semantics are unresolved.
Default/Hover source-to-class declaration checks do not establish native pseudo-state, SVG contours, host layout, font loading or playback.
